A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 19 readable pages including Appendices A–L. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish complete correspondence apart from the version stamp and one algorithm-caption correction.

before.justification: v1 reports original training and test experiments in Section 4, plus codebook-size, clustering-level, and out-of-distribution experiments in Appendices J–L.

after.justification: v2 retains the authors' original training and test results in Section 4 and the additional empirical analyses in Appendices J–L.

M1.justification: The hierarchical policy, VQVAE subgoal generator, clustering, and training procedures remain identical. Algorithm 3's corrected title does not change its inputs, outputs, or search steps.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Box-World, CraftWorld, BoulderDash, Sokoban, and TSP coverage, including the same standard, hard, and out-of-distribution scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within every experiment: LevinTS and PHS* with their original policies, Weighted A* with weight 1.5, and HIPS-ε retain their respective participation and omissions.

E3.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendices F–I retain the same data splits, preprocessing, model configurations, training schedules, expansion/time budgets, metrics, and test procedures.

E4.justification: The solution-only training ablation in Figure 3, codebook-size and clustering-level analyses in Appendices J–K, and BoulderDash distribution-shift test in Appendix L are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five training seeds and retain the same training-curve means and minimum–maximum shaded ranges. No statistical or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and all result plots contain identical values, entries, and trends. No numerical corrections or new qualitative findings appear.

T1.justification: The problem definitions, Equations 1–7, completeness argument in Section 3.5, and mathematical explanations in the appendices are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning online subgoal learning, learning from failed searches, completeness, and sample efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning Sokoban performance, reconstruction-error tolerance, computational costs, and the appendix ablation and robustness findings remain identical.

D1.justification: Appendices G–I retain identical implementation, hardware, architecture, hyperparameter, data-generation, and code/data access information.

R1.justification: The references and research positioning are unchanged, including Section 5's comparisons with subgoal search, goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, and VQVAE-based subgoal generation.

P1.justification: Appendix B changes Algorithm 3's title from 'Policy-Guided Policy Tree Search' to 'Policy-Guided Heuristic Tree Search'. The arXiv version/date stamp also updates; other wording and document organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Algorithm 3 receives a caption-only correction. Its displayed pseudocode and placement, all six figures, all seven tables, and the surrounding page layout remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects a local naming typo in Appendix B, where the adjacent prose already identified PHS* correctly. All scientific arguments, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information remain identical, so this small editorial correction does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
